newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Stanley leads 39 bln peseta 2-tranche bond.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley leads 39 bln peseta 2-tranche bond.

text.p: The following two-tranche bond was announced by lead manager Morgan Stanley for Fondo de Titulizacion Hypotecaria Hypotebanca 5.
Class A notes total 38.025 billion pesetas, and Banco Santander is international coordinator on this tranche.
Class B notes total 1.075 billion pesetas.
